study type: Multicenter randomized trial with retrospective cohort analysis
outcome: 95th/5th centile of the umbilical artery (UA) Doppler
Classification of late fetal growth restriction
cohort: The study included 4,505 low-risk pregnant women for initial modeling, and later retrospectively evaluated 682 small for gestational age (SGA)-suspected fetuses.
finding: Physiological characteristics significantly influenced the 95th/5th centile of the UA and CPR PI, and adjusting Doppler standards could differentiate better between FGR and SGA.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at 36+ weeks, specifically between 36-39 weeks, and retrospectively applied at 37 weeks.
